_comment: Hand-made stopgap entries for songs upstream's data doesn't have yet. Takes precedence over missing-songs-auto.json (generated daily from arcade-songs), so use this only to correct or add what the generated file gets wrong or lacks. Only fills gaps: a song upstream knows (by name + chart type) is skipped. lv is [Basic, Advanced, Expert, Master(, Re:Master)]; negative = only the official level is known (its minimum constant, e.g. 12+ -> -12.6), positive = exact internal constant. Example: {"name": "OV3RCLOCK", "genre": "maimai", "dx": 1, "debut": 27, "lv": [6, 7.9, 12.6, 14.8], "regionOverrides": {"intl": {"debut": 26}}}
